description: List folders of a given type as a nested tree with id, name, parentId, and children. STRONGLY RECOMMENDED to pass folderId for large projects to return only that subtree — full project trees can exceed response size limits.

folderId.description: Return only this folder and its children (subtree). Strongly recommended for large projects.

response_format.description: Output format. 'markdown' is human-readable; 'json' (default) is machine-readable.

name: qtm4j_list_folders
title: List Folders
